title: 第5722章 主战内部第5721章 剧烈摇晃
lines: 剧烈的爆炸声令整个甲板颤抖，指挥仓里的里昂以及其他指挥官随之摇晃，险些摔倒。
他们在屏幕中看见一团爆炸火光，似乎有炸碎皮肉喷溅在镜头上，整个画面变得血红。
里昂等人震惊、愤怒、狂躁，可目前情况是手下的大兵们根本拿那个混蛋没有办法。
“不遗余力，杀！”
“调动所有人，杀！”
“把他给我轰碎，杀！”
里昂大声咆哮着，其余高级指挥官理解里昂上将的愤怒，但他们并不认同这个华夏人会如此强悍，他一定有同伴在这船上，或者是己方的丑啯大兵们还是轻敌了。
内舱中……
林昆想法很简单，能杀两个绝不杀一个，能屠整个绝对，绝不放走一个。
当鲜血喷溅在这个曾经漠北狼王的眼前，那久违沙场上浴血奋战记忆苏醒，一团胸腔里沸腾血液，在这一瞬间被点燃，为国家、为人民、为这世界苍生，也为自己！
战！
战到最后一滴血！
战到整片海洋燃烧！
第一小队丑啯大兵全军覆没，第三小队的丑啯大兵被施莱德身体里的炸弹崩飞数人。
不等第三小队从震惊、愤怒中回过神，硝烟弥漫中，一个高瘦身影出现，手中一把乌金色三棱军刺，在火光映射下，他浑身散发出冰冷杀气，令人不寒而栗。
有大兵警觉回过头，看到这个身影，顿时抬起手中枪就要射击，口中大喊：“他在……”
噗嗤！
扳机刚扣动下一半，嘴里话还未说完，三棱军刺直接穿透他的喉咙，在鲜血喷溅起的一刹那，他涣散的眼神看到紧跟着冲过来的人影，这将是他此生见过最后一个人，一张令他从小就讨厌的东方面孔。
其余人听到声音纷纷回过头，此时的林昆手中握着带血的三棱军刺，身手矫捷如同一道闪电，在人群中穿梭，所过之处这些丑啯大兵皆是突然僵在原地，等他长呼一口气，站在这群人最前面的时候，这些人齐刷刷捂着脖子倒下去。
又有丑啯大兵赶过来，察觉到这边情况不对，立刻不管现场是否有同伴在场，直接开始扣动扳机。
子弹如同雨点一般普天盖地，呼啸而来。
紧跟着二十多名丑啯大兵冲过来，检查现场之后发现，地上除了同伴尸体，并未看见其他人。
硝烟弥漫中，又是一大片脚步声围过来，其他几组丑啯大兵也赶过来，现场聚集将近一百五十余人。
所有人都在认真寻找尸体，就刚才这种疯狂扫射情况，不可能有人活下来，连逃跑机会都没有。
可活要见人死要见尸，那么大一个活人，就是怎么也看不到。
content_en:
The violent explosion made the entire deck tremble, causing Leon and other commanders in the command cabin to shake and almost fall.
They saw an explosion of fire on the screen, and it seemed like pieces of flesh and skin were splattered on the camera lens, and the entire screen turned blood red.
Leon and others were shocked, angry, and furious, but the current situation was that the soldiers under his command had no way to deal with that bastard.
"Spend no effort and kill!"
"Mobilize everyone and kill!"
"Blast him to pieces and kill him!"
Lyon roared loudly. The other senior commanders understood General Lyon's anger, but they did not agree that this Chinese would be so tough. He must have companions on the ship, or his own ugly soldiers still underestimated the enemy.
In the inner cabin...
Lin Kun's idea is very simple. If he can kill two, he will never kill one. If he can kill all of them, he will never let one go.
When the blood splashed in front of the eyes of the former Wolf King of Mobei, the memory of the long-lost bloody battle on the battlefield awakened, and a ball of boiling blood in the chest was ignited at this moment, for the country, for the people, for the people of the world, and for myself!
war!
Fight to the last drop of blood!
Fight until the entire ocean burns!
The first squad of ugly soldiers were wiped out, and the third squad of ugly soldiers were blown away by the bomb in Shredder's body.
Before the third team could recover from the shock and anger, a tall and thin figure appeared in the smoke, holding a black-gold triangular military thorn in his hand. Under the reflection of the fire, his whole body exuded a cold murderous aura, which made people shudder.
A soldier turned around alertly. When he saw this figure, he immediately raised his gun and was about to shoot, shouting: "He is..."
Poof!
The trigger had just been pulled halfway, and before he could finish his words, the three-sided military spike penetrated his throat directly. At the moment when blood spattered, his distracted eyes saw the figure rushing towards him. This would be the last person he saw in his life, an oriental face that he had hated since he was a child.
The rest of the people turned around when they heard the voice. At this time, Lin Kun was holding a bloody three-edged military thorn in his hand. He was as agile as lightning and shuttled through the crowd. Wherever he passed, these ugly soldiers suddenly froze in place. When he took a long breath and stood at the front of the group, these people all fell down holding their necks.
Another ugly soldier came over and realized something was wrong here. He immediately started to pull the trigger regardless of whether his companions were present or not.
Bullets covered the sky and covered the ground like raindrops, roaring in.
More than 20 Chou soldiers rushed over, and after checking the scene, they found that except for the corpses of their companions, no one else was seen on the ground.
In the thick smoke, another large group of footsteps came around, and several other groups of ugly soldiers also rushed over. Nearly 150 people gathered at the scene.
Everyone was looking for the corpse seriously. With the crazy shooting just now, it was impossible for anyone to survive, and there was no chance of escape.
But if you want to see a person alive, you want to see a corpse if you die. For such a big living person, you just can't see it.
